column12: Application code written for the client. Assigned to the client on payment of the gate.
Devicetree and board configuration for T1 hardware rev C.
Factory test-station scripts. Not on the device. Loads device identity issued by the client's CA.
Vendor SDK. Licensed by Nordic; cannot be assigned. Use limited to Nordic silicon.
LTE-M / NB-IoT / GNSS modem firmware. Runs on the modem core. Version is tied to the certification reports.
Secure bootloader. Verifies image signatures with the client's public key.
JSON encode / decode for telemetry payloads.
CBOR encoding for compact uplink messages.
IMU driver for motion and shock detection.
Protobuf encoding. Only if the client's backend uses protobuf.
Build toolchain. Not on the device. Recorded so builds can be reproduced.
